[[File:1-M.jpg|thumb|right|253x253px|A [[Imperial Repulsortank 1-M]] in service with the Imperial Army.]]
A medium repulsortank was a type of [[Hovertank|hovering]] [[Tank/Legends|tank]] that used [[repulsorlift]] technology to propel each vehicle forward. These [[Hovertank/Legends|repulsortanks]] did not have the same [[Armor/Legends|armor]] or firepower as a [[heavy repulsortank]]. Nor did they have the same speed, mobility and maneuverability as an [[light repulsortank]]. Instead, they were supposed to be a combination of the best element from both classes. Sometimes the opposite happened.<ref name="J9">{{JournalCite|9|Repulsortank Battlefield}}</ref>

==Imperial army==
Medium repulsortank was an official classification in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial army]]. Eight would be part of an imperial [[armor platoon]] plus a command vehicle. By contrast [[heavy repulsortank]]s would be organized into platoons with only four.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> The number could could be doubled with the addition of four more [[armor section]]s. Each armor section would have two medium repulsortank.<ref name="ISB2">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref>
